s_input = input()
s_output = ""
at_used = False
i = 0

def match_dot(idx):
    return s_input[idx:idx+3] == "dot"

def match_at(idx):
    return s_input[idx:idx+2] == "at"

while i < len(s_input):
    if i > 0 and i + 2 < len(s_input) and match_dot(i):
        s_output += '.'
        i += 3
        continue
    if not at_used and i > 0 and i + 1 < len(s_input) and match_at(i):
        s_output += '@'
        i += 2
        at_used = True
        continue
    s_output += s_input[i]
    i += 1

print(s_output)
